title: UCI Road World Championships 2025
metaDescription: The 2025 UCI Road World Championships took place in Kigali, Rwanda, the first African host for cycling's annual road title week.

overview.about: The UCI Road World Championships crown the world champions in road cycling each autumn, with the winners earning the right to wear the rainbow jersey for a year. The elite men's and women's road races are the blue-riband events, run over a demanding one-day circuit, and the host city changes annually.
overview.nextEvent: The UCI Road World Championships are held over a week each September, with elite men's and women's road races, time trials and a mixed relay. The host city changes every year, taking the sport to new audiences around the world.
